Planning your visit to Peacock Theatre

Peacock Theatre
Portugal St, London WC2A 2HT

Find more information on transport in our section on getting to Peacock Theatre.

Booking tickets

You can book your tickets online.

Get in touch

If you have any questions about your booking or need assistance, please get in touch with our Ticket Office using the button below. We’re always happy to help.

Contact our Ticket Office

Cloakroom and lost property

We have a cloakroom for small items and coats. Just so you know, we can’t store large bags, suitcases or backpacks.

For lost property, please email reception@sadlerswells.com.

Get here early

We recommend arriving 30 minutes before the performance starts, so you can soak up the pre-show atmosphere and find your seat in time.

The Peacock is open one hour before performances.

Food and drink

Pre-order your drinks and take in the buzz of the theatre at one of our bars. More information about eating and drinking at The Peacock can be found here.

Eating and drinking during the performance

We serve a selection of drinks and snacks before the performance and during the interval from our bars on each level. The average price for snacks, including ice cream, is £4.

We understand that people want to bring their own snacks. As a courtesy to other audience members, please don’t eat hot food or packed lunches.

You can take drinks into the auditorium if they’re in plastic bottles or cups, but no glass please.

Children

We put on some family-friendly performances, but generally speaking, we don’t allow children under the age of five in the audience.

If the show allows children under five, under twos go free. If you’re a parent or carer, please book aisle seats to make getting in and out easier.

Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult.

Filming and photography

We don’t allow recording on any cameras, mobile phones or other recording equipment in the auditorium.

Respect

We ask that you treat our staff and your fellow audience members with respect. We have a zero-tolerance approach to any intimidating, aggressive or threatening behaviour.

Getting to Peacock Theatre

Our Address

Peacock Theatre
Portugal St, London WC2A 2HT

Access

Peacock Theatre is fully accessible. Information about accessibility at this venue can be found here.

You can find further information about accessibility across Sadler’s Wells, including our Access for All Scheme here.

If you have any questions, please get in touch with our team at the Ticket Office. We’re always happy to help.  

In person: The Peacock Theatre ticket office is only open in person one hour before a performance start time.

Phone: Our phoneline (020 7863 8000) is open from 12 – 6pm, Monday – Saturday.

tickets@sadlerswells.com

Public transport

It’s easy to reach us using public transport. To plan your journey and for up to date information, visit the TFL Journey Planner

Bus

Three bus stops close to the theatre are served by a number of routes.

High Holborn 8, 19, 38, 22B, 25, 188, 501, 521

Kingsway 1, 68, 91, 168, 171, 188, 501, 505, 521, X68

Aldwych/Strand 4, 11, 15, 23, 26, 76, 171, 341

Tube

Holborn (Central/Piccadilly Lines) and Temple (District/Circle Lines) are both nearby and a 5-minute walk from theatre.

Congestion charge

Peacock Theatre is inside London’s congestion charge zone.

Please check the TFL website to find out when the congestion charge applies.

For information on exemptions, discounts and how to pay, visit Transport for London.

Coach

There is a limited amount of space for coaches to park on Kingsway and Portugal Street.

Please make sure the coach is not parked on the double yellow lines, or in the bus stop. To help reduce noise and air pollution, please make sure the engine is switched off when parked outside the theatre.

Bike

There are bike racks outside and opposite the theatre, and several cycle hire stations nearby.

Things to do in the area for families

Eat at The Delaunay Counter
Enjoy a family meal and receive 10% off when showing your theatre ticket at the counter. Located on Drury Lane, The Delaunay offers a relaxed but stylish atmosphere and a tasty children menu. Don’t miss their cakes and hot chocolate, the perfect treat after a show.

Play at Lincoln’s Inn Fields
London’s largest public square, just 2–3 minutes away. There’s a nice playground with climbing frames and sand play. Lots of space for picnics or a run around.

Explore Somerset House Courtyard
About 8 minutes’ walk from The Peacock, kids can enjoy splashing in the courtyard fountains (in summer) or seeing the giant Christmas tree (in winter). There’s also regular family-friendly exhibitions and workshops, especially during half-terms.

Visit Covent Garden Piazza
A 5 minutes’ walk from the theatre, there’s plenty to see for the kids, from bustling street performers, magicians, bubble shows, and the Apple Market! Plus many places to grab a treat like ice cream from Venchi or biscuits from Ben’s Cookies.

Get 10% Off at The Delaunay Counter with your Show Ticket

Located near the Peacock Theatre, at the corner between Aldwych and Drury Lane, The Delaunay Counter Café and Bar is adjacent to the main restaurant and features classic European Alpine dishes, regionally sourced wines and beers, and a seasonal cocktail menu. Get 10% discount on your total bill when showing your ticket upon arrival*.
